lines.en: I walk among the coral cracks.
I kick up sand from the seabed.
A mantis shrimp does not walk; it glides.
I creep along the reef on my belly legs.

lines.zh: 红树林的水浑，正好藏身。
lines.en: Mangrove water is murky, good for hiding.
I move sideways like a stone.
My burrow is in the reef flat.
I skirt the anemone; it stings.
The warm current pushes me along.
I stop every few steps to listen.
Coral branches block me; I slip through.

lines.zh: 沙地上有我拖出来的沟。
lines.en: I leave a groove behind in the sand.
When the tide drops, the reef opens up.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走，拳头随时能出。
lines.en: I walk slowly, fists ready to fire.

lines.zh: 我用尾扇一推，滑出半尺。
lines.en: One push of my tail fan slides me half a foot.

lines.zh: 我从洞里出来，先看四周。
lines.en: I leave my burrow and check around first.
Crawling on the seabed, sand over my back.
This fist can smash a shell.
I squeeze through a coral gap.
One coin is missing from my hoard.
Punching the seafloor, I walk two steps.
My shell plates grind and creak.
Eight points of armor. One step at a time.

lines.zh: 我的拳头能把贝壳敲开。
lines.en: My punch cracks shells open.
This wind smells of mountains.
The sand sinks under my steps.

lines.zh: 海底这条沟，我走过一百回。
lines.en: I have crossed this trench a hundred times.

lines.zh: 整片海床都是我的猎场。
lines.en: This whole seabed is my hunting ground.
I am grinding my fists.
My punch is faster than a blink.

lines.zh: 珊瑚里住着一整片声音。
lines.en: The coral holds a whole world of sound.
I count the sand grains at my burrow.
Shulkers are my favorite dish.
Eight layers of shell; nothing bites through.

lines.zh: 我不主动惹事，只是别惹我。
lines.en: I start nothing, but do not provoke me.
My eyes look two ways at once; convenient.
Light in the water spins on my shell.
One punch cracks a seashell.
My burrow holds shells others dropped.

lines.zh: 拳击有节奏，我练了很久。
lines.en: There is rhythm in my strike; I practiced long.

lines.zh: 潮水的声音，比岸上安静。
lines.en: The tide sounds quieter than the shore.
I keep to this one stretch of reef.
The light patch at my burrow drifts.
I can guard one burrow all day.
Too lazy to move today.

lines.zh: 我的拳里存着一次爆响。
lines.en: My punch holds one crack ready.

lines.zh: 我躲在沙洞里，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I hide in my sand burrow with only my eyes out.
This fist of mine can crack shells.
My fists are waiting to smash a shell.
Dark burrow, perfect for another nap.
In my burrow, listening to the current.
I buff my shell with fine sand.
My dreams are all gold.

lines.zh: 这个洞对甲壳来说太窄。
lines.en: This burrow is too narrow for my shell.
Claws tucked at my burrow mouth, dozing.
My club joint still holds a charge.
You are standing on my reef.
You are too close to my burrow.
I raise a fist; you decide.
Your reflection blocks my light.

lines.zh: 我盯你的膝盖，那里好打。
lines.en: I aim at your knee; it is a good target.
You are clumsier in the water than I am.
Do not slap the water with your hand.
I raise both eyestalks to look at you.
Your boots crushed the coral.

lines.zh: 个子再大，也是一拳的事。
lines.en: However big you are, it takes one punch.

lines.zh: 你要是伸手，我可不客气。
lines.en: Reach in, and I will not be gentle.
The light on your face keeps moving.
I back into the burrow, only my fist showing.
Once you have looked enough, go ashore.
You are stepping on my territory's sand.
Interesting; you are not running.
The prey actually looks back at me.
My raptorial claw rises, aimed at you.
One tremor in the water and I know.

lines.zh: 海沙里没闻过你这种味。
lines.en: I've never smelled your kind in this sand.

lines.zh: 复眼把你的动作全拆开了。
lines.en: My compound eyes break your movement apart.

lines.zh: 我这双拳，能烧穿你的皮。
lines.en: These fists can burn through your shell.
One punch from me cracks a shell.

lines.zh: 你脚上包着奇怪的硬壳。
lines.en: Your feet are wrapped in strange hard shell.
Look up. Not down.

lines.zh: 又一条鱼游进我的猎场。
lines.en: Another fish swims into my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我的拳头比你的眼睛快。
lines.en: My punch is faster than your eye.
Your toes trample the sand.

lines.zh: 鱿鱼和龙虾，都在我名单上。
lines.en: Squid and lobster are both on my list.

lines.zh: 暖水的礁石下，你探什么？
lines.en: What are you probing under this warm reef?
The shell cracked with a dull sound.
Even eight shell layers got pierced.
I do not retreat, but that was heavy.
For a moment I cannot lift my fist.
Water has seeped into the crack.

lines.zh: 我记得这一下，待会还你。
lines.en: I remember that; I will return it.
One of my eyestalks is bent.
There are eggs in the burrow; do not smash it.
I shrink into the reef crack.
Pain is pain, but the fist remains.
A fine crack opens in my shell.
A cracked scale. Painful.
Not enough to make me raise a claw.

lines.zh: 敢敲我的甲壳，胆子不小。
lines.en: Daring to strike my shell, bold little thing.
My claw is stuck and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我的拳套磕在石头上了。
lines.en: My club hit a rock instead.
Shell cracked. The fist still works.
Who? Who did that?

lines.zh: 等我弹出一拳你就知道。
lines.en: Wait until my punch lands.
My shell has several layers.
That tropical fish, hand it over.
Ten fish can buy my trust.
Not enough; bring twenty more.

lines.zh: 我看到潜影贝就挪不动。
lines.en: Shulkers make my feet stop moving.
Lower the fish and I will take it.
Fish from salt water taste freshest.

lines.zh: 我数着，这已经是第九条。
lines.en: I am counting; this is already the ninth.
Stop shaking, or the fish will drop.
This smells better than coral.
For one fish I can come closer.
My arms open, and not to pinch.
The fin is still moving; very fresh.
Steady your hand a little more.
Once done, I want another one.
It's just that my claw moved first.
I may take it, yes?

lines.zh: 鱼腥味顺着水飘过来了。
lines.en: Fish scent drifts down the current.
A dragon's appetite is vast.
Is that prey for me?
Is that the smell of squid?
That fish in your hand glints.
These fists have cracked shells.
A sheep? A whole one?
My fist is faster than your blade.
You knocked my burrow askew.
I slid sideways half a meter.
Do not kick the reef with your foot.
That one threw up all the sand.

lines.zh: 我夹在你的鞋和礁之间。
lines.en: I am stuck between your shoe and the reef.
My fist hit solid stone.
Back off; I need to right myself.
You stepped down my burrow entrance.
I slide away; my shell is intact.
You have muddied the water.

lines.zh: 你被我的拳风扫到了吧。
lines.en: My punch's shockwave caught you, did it?
Don't push my shell, back off.
Bumping into me is your bad luck.

lines.zh: 我这一拳打出去，水都裂了。
lines.en: My punch goes out and the water splits.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳比你的骨头硬。
lines.en: My shell is harder than your bones.
My strike is faster than sound.
My shell bumps you, hard as stone.
I block the sandy path sideways.
Hey, back up, these fists are fast.
Who struck me? Stand still.
I drum the reef with my fist for her.
The burrow is lined with fine sand, warm enough.
The brighter our colors, the better.
She enters first; I guard outside.
Three knocks is the courting rhythm.
The eggs will stick to the burrow wall.
I am patient; the tide will bring her.
Two fists touch, only lightly.
She is gone; the burrow is still warm.
The reef is quiet, only water sounds.
Take this gem. It is yours.
Shall we hunt a wild ox together?

lines.zh: 我的拳头一出，贝壳就碎。
lines.en: One punch of mine and the shell shatters.
My punch is faster than the current.

lines.zh: 你愿意和我一起在水里冲吗？
lines.en: Will you charge through the water with me?

lines.zh: 别怕，这次我把拳头收着。
lines.en: Do not worry, I am holding my punch back.
I've dug a burrow under the reef.
Come. Watch the sunset with me.

lines.zh: 这一拳下去，壳上会留坑。
lines.en: One punch of mine leaves a dent in shell.
My punch is faster than sound.
I keep this coral fragment.
I grip it with my front limbs.
A shell shard fits the burrow mouth.
Too heavy; I push it along.
This stone has a hole; it will do.
It carries another shrimp's scent.
I carry it back and block my door.
Useless; I kick it aside.
Every stone I pick up goes home.
The bigger the opening, the more I fix it.
The fish chunk that sank, I take it.

lines.zh: 这小东西，夹在螯里正好。
lines.en: This little thing fits my claw just right.
The sunken shell, I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 我这一拳，能把鱿鱼壳打裂。
lines.en: One punch of mine cracks a squid's shell.
Another piece of plunder.

lines.zh: 它自己跑到我这双拳下的。
lines.en: It wandered right under these fists.
Item twenty thousand. Filed away.
Claws work better than hands.
I nudge it into a rock crevice and hide it.
The weight drags my shell down.
You stepped on my reef.
I gave you a chance already.
Now it is my fist's turn.
Three steps back, and it is not too late.
You cannot run fast in the reef cracks.
I have your ankle in my sights.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: When the water moves, I know where you are.
Do not back behind the coral.

lines.zh: 我的拳能打穿这块石头。
lines.en: My fist can punch through this stone.
If you want a fight, stand still.

lines.zh: 海底的洞，我进去就不出来。
lines.en: Into the seabed burrow, and I stay out of sight.
My punch is faster than a bullet.

lines.zh: 你搅起的沙暴露出位置。
lines.en: The sand you stir reveals where you are.

lines.zh: 两只复眼各盯着你一半。
lines.en: Each compound eye tracks half of you.
No way out behind this reef.
This fish can't get away.
My punch picks hard shells.
Sand kicks up as I rush at you.
Your shadow fell into my burrow.
This punch cracks stone.

lines.zh: 沙一扬，我的螯已经上膛。
lines.en: Sand kicks up; my club is already cocked.
Just one punch away.
My claw springs out, just reaching you.

lines.zh: 我这双锤节，早就上好了。
lines.en: These hammer clubs have long been cocked.
I track sideways without turning.
Your foot moves; so do I.
I wait for you to enter the circle.
The burrow mouth is my line.
I measure the range; half an inch off.
Sand rises and hides you.
The more you retreat, the murkier it gets.
I will not chase beyond this reef.
My fist stays cocked for an opening.
Let us stand off; my fist does not tire.
The faster you swim, the more excited I get.
My eyes turn separately, both on you.
Watching you panic is amusing.
Chasing your wake forward.
You kicked up the sand at my burrow.
This fist goes through your shell.

lines.zh: 潜影贝是我最爱的点心。
lines.en: Shulkers are my favourite snack.
I follow your footprints in the sand.
My claw is faster than your legs.
Your movements keep slowing.
My compound eyes sort every color.
You can't escape this reef flat.
My punch is faster than your eye.
Stop, and you'll take fewer hits.
I haven't sprung my claw yet.
This punch is too fast for sound.
A small crater bursts on the surface.
You were flung two steps back.
The reef got a hole punched in it.
My punch lands hot enough to burn.
However thick the shell, it fails.
Your sleeve scorched a little.
One hit is already enough.
I pull my fist back and stand straight.
Do not make me throw a second punch.
Back off. Do not stain my scales.
My claw snaps out and cracks against you.
This punch is faster than a bullet.

lines.zh: 别站着，我这一拳会打空。
lines.en: Don't just stand there; my punch will miss.
A clean hit on your knee, a crisp crack.
This punch is heard underwater.
Look closely, this is my raptorial claw.
My punch grazes your leg.
This punch can shatter shell.
One punch and the water shakes.
Shell fragments spray up.
The sea is shoved into a ring by my punch.
This punch is heard underwater — 螳螂虾, melee attack

lines.zh: 珊瑚缝里的鱿鱼，跑不掉了。
lines.en: The squid in the coral crack won't escape.
Warm sea, with dense coral.
I picked an empty piece of reef.
The mangrove roots will do as well.
Dig the burrow first; everything else after.
The current is gentle, just right.
I am the only one on this reef.
The coral's shadow hides me.
When I was born my shell was soft.
Mouth facing the current brings food in.
I remember the warm current here.

lines.zh: 海底的沙地上全是脚印。
lines.en: The seabed sand is covered in tracks.

lines.zh: 礁石缝里全是我的地盘。
lines.en: Every crack in the reef is mine.
Little one, don't step on my burrow.
This seabed is still mine.

lines.zh: 礁石缝里，我的洞口刚通。
lines.en: My burrow through the reef just opened.
First, flex both my claws.
From a reef crack, my eye stalks rise.
My shell is warm, time to move.
I am awake.
Who's rummaging on my reef flat?
Let me find a fish first.

lines.zh: 我从水底爬到这块石头上。
lines.en: I climbed from the seabed to this rock.
Who's knocking on the reef?

lines.zh: 从沙洞里探出半个身子。
lines.en: Half my body out of the sand burrow.

lines.zh: 水流带来了陌生的血味。
lines.en: The current carries an unfamiliar blood scent.
A shrimp just poked out of the reef crack.
The water boils; my shell turns white.
The water is boiling, my shell burns.
Fell on the reef and chipped my armor.
Wings. Hold on.
I live underwater, yet I am drowning.
Swept into deep water, my shell grows heavy.
The reef flat has been blown open wide.

lines.zh: 爆炸震得洞穴塌了半边。
lines.en: The blast caves in half my burrow.
An arrow is stuck in my armor seam.
Something lodged in my scales.
No wound on my armor, but something rings inside.
Cursed force rings through my shell.
Five days without fish; my fist feels soft.
Feed me or face my temper.
The surface flashed and the reef went white.

lines.zh: 海水一热，我的彩壳就发白。
lines.en: Warm water burns my shell pale.
No water here, and no reef either.
I fall with no bottom.
